method: Plan-only blind comparison 2026-11-24: one fresh agent per version followed its copy of SKILL.md (testing section removed), its references and the reviewer agent file on six scenarios that stated no expected result; a third agent graded both transcripts against fixed criteria without knowing which version was which. Baseline is origin/main. One run per version; no command of the skill was executed. Both runners used a shell read of the references despite the no-commands instruction (one also a heredoc write, the other one Glob). S1-c, S2-a, S6-a and S6-b test rules added in this round. After the run, step 8 gained a cut-off check and step 9 the words '(text and metadata)'.

assertions_evaluated.text: the reviewer is dispatched before any verification or status command
only the import verification is recorded, not quality again
assertions_evaluated.evidence: L33: "`--kind quality` is not run again"

assertions_evaluated.text: the user is asked to approve the text before any verification is recorded
